title: Secure admin access - private route locations withheld
rules: The CSV requires secure login with MFA/OTP support and secure expiry. Shared documents must not reveal the private admin sign-in location. Logical operations below intentionally have no URL; location and security configuration are distributed privately.

Admin accounts are separate from garage-owner/customer identities. No public registration or self-promotion is permitted. Passwords and codes are placeholders; never include real credentials in client documents.

Proposed baseline: password plus mandatory MFA for administrative access. TOTP is recommended; an approved verified OTP factor may be used instead. Challenge and proof must be purpose-bound, short-lived, single-use and rate-limited.

Invalid credentials use generic errors. Token rotation/reuse detection, secure device storage, session revocation, recent MFA for privileged actions and administrative session timeout need final approval. Existing password/session support does not imply MFA is implemented.

endpoints.title: Private operation: begin admin sign-in
endpoints.rules: identifier and password required; device_name optional. Do not issue a business-data access token before the required factor passes.

endpoints.title: Private operation: complete admin MFA
endpoints.rules: Both fields required. code is a string. This is a proposed private MFA contract, not an exposed route.

endpoints.title: Private operation: refresh admin session
endpoints.rules: refresh_token required; reject revoked/expired/reused credentials.

endpoints.title: Private operation: revoke current session
endpoints.rules: Revoke current session and refresh credentials; protected access must honor revocation.

title: Identity, roles and permission-aware navigation
rules: RBAC is enforced server-side for every read, export and mutation, not only by hiding screens. Cross-garage access is limited to the admin's permitted data scope.

Proposed functional permissions are shown per operation. CEO may receive approved full access; operations, finance and support roles receive least privilege. Role names do not bypass permission checks.

Role assignment requires security.manage and recent MFA. Prevent self-escalation and removing the last active security administrator. Log before/after permission changes and revoke/re-evaluate affected sessions.
Staff/role reads and role assignment are required to support AUS-20. Creating/deleting staff accounts or dynamic role creation is outside these stories; provisioning stays deliberate and private.

endpoints.title: Read admin identity and effective permissions
endpoints.rules: Return effective permissions, permitted garage scope and current identity; never return credential hashes.

endpoints.title: Read authorized admin menus
endpoints.rules: Return only authorized menu keys; private sign-in routes are never included.

endpoints.title: List admin staff and assigned roles
Assign approved roles/data scope
endpoints.rules: All fields required. role_ids must be valid approved roles; type is PLATFORM or GARAGES. GARAGES requires nonempty unique garage_ids. Reject escalation outside grantor authority.

title: Executive dashboard and consistent analytics
rules: Common filters: date_from, date_to, timezone, city, garage_id, service_id. Apply the same normalized filters, permission scope and snapshot to all cards/charts.
Server generates snapshot_id/as_of on initial read. Clients may pass snapshot_id on subsequent related dashboard/statistics/export reads. Expired snapshots produce 409 and require reload.

Dashboard customer/garage counts are distinct participants in the selected segment/time range; lifetime totals require a separate explicitly-labelled view. Active job statuses are OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_PARTS, QUALITY_CHECK and READY.

Financial net_collected_amount means confirmed gross captured payments minus settled refunds, including tax; it is not profit or statutory revenue. Return taxes/discounts separately and approve the accounting definition.

endpoints.title: Read executive KPI dashboard
endpoints.rules: Filters are optional; default date window must be returned explicitly. Proposed metrics extend the existing dashboard contract.

endpoints.title: Read filtered time-series charts
endpoints.rules: period supports daily, weekly, monthly or custom. Chart time buckets and metric definitions must match the dashboard.

title: Garage owners, profiles and operational controls
rules: Owner identity and garage identity are distinct; one owner can manage several garages. Lists include ratings, booking/job/revenue aggregates and selected filters.
Operational status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED) and verification status (UNVERIFIED, VERIFIED) are separate controls. Verification does not silently activate a suspended garage.

Suspension blocks discovery/new bookings according to approved policy, while preserving historical records and handling existing work explicitly. Status changes are audited with reason, actor and timestamp.
Support/complaint counts link to support tickets; garage profile includes active services, hours, invoices, reviews and recent activity without exposing credential or bank secrets.

endpoints.title: List garage owners and activity
endpoints.rules: Optional search, owner status, city, min_rating, garage_id and reporting filters. Account status is not garage operational status.

endpoints.title: Inspect garage profile and operations
endpoints.rules: Collections in this summary are bounded previews. Related bookings/jobs/invoices/support APIs allow garage_id filtering and pagination.

endpoints.title: Activate or suspend garage
endpoints.rules: All fields required. Use expected_version for concurrency; sample change targets garage_002, separate from active garage_001.

endpoints.title: Verify garage
endpoints.rules: All fields required. Verification/reversal transitions need policy; changing verification does not override operational suspension.

endpoints.title: Inspect garage ratings/reviews
endpoints.rules: Inspection only; review moderation writes are not requested in this source.

title: Customer account and risk monitoring
rules: Customer login identities must be distinguished from garage-owned contact records. Cross-platform customer reads require customers.read; do not mistake owner accounts for customer identities.
Customer list filters include search, account_status, inactive_since, last activity, failed-payment count and support flags. Define the inactivity threshold in configuration.
Profile shows paginated linked vehicles, bookings, jobs, invoices, payment attempts, reviews and support tickets. Return permission-filtered summaries and use related list endpoints for drill-down.
The source requests identifying inactive/blocked accounts, not authority to block/delete customers. No customer-blocking, impersonation or credential reset operation is added.

endpoints.title: List customers and risk flags
endpoints.rules: All filters optional and combined with AND. Optional inactive_since uses last_activity_at before the supplied cutoff, with never-active handling defined in policy.

endpoints.title: Inspect customer and linked records
endpoints.rules: Linked finance details additionally require finance.read. Paginate full related data via the dedicated lists; vehicle and review list operations below complete the profile drill-down.

title: Booking monitoring and exception trends
rules: Read-only monitoring; admin does not accept/reject or convert bookings on behalf of a garage in this requirements baseline.
Booking states: PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, CONVERTED, EXPIRED. Include actor, timestamps, rejection/cancellation/expiry reasons and linked job where available.
Exception charts break down rejected/cancelled/expired bookings by reason, owner, city and time using the same filter/snapshot convention. Missing reasons are explicitly categorized as UNSPECIFIED.

endpoints.title: Read booking exception breakdowns
endpoints.rules: group_by supports owner, garage, reason, city, day. Date basis is the exception transition timestamp.

title: Job monitoring, timeline and delay alerts
rules: Job states: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_PARTS, QUALITY_CHECK, READY, COMPLETED, CANCELLED. Return complete authorized detail without granting job-edit/status-change powers.
Delay detection uses configured thresholds per service/state and recorded timestamps. State duration starts at entry into the current state; overall overdue compares an approved due_at against as_of.
Jobs waiting for parts are filterable independently of being overdue. Alerts show measured duration, threshold and the current delay reason. Configuration ownership must be approved.

endpoints.title: Inspect job findings and charges
endpoints.rules: Mask restricted notes/financial fields where the admin lacks their permissions.

endpoints.title: Identify delayed/waiting jobs
endpoints.rules: Return as_of in list metadata; sample durations measured at 2026-10-08T15:00:00+05:30.

endpoints.title: Read operational delay alerts
endpoints.rules: Alert generation/deduplication must be defined; this read API does not imply a customer notification or intervention mutation.

title: Finance, invoices, payments, refunds and disputes
rules: Finance is read-only investigation/reporting in the source. No payment-status override, refund initiation, charge, invoice-edit or missing-bill repair endpoint is proposed.
Amounts are integer paise, INR. Full/partial refunds are separate settled financial events, not failed payment attempts. Reconcile capture/refund amounts before reporting.
Sanitize gateway responses: expose approved response codes, timestamps and transaction references only. Exclude secrets, signatures, card/bank details and raw unrestricted gateway payloads.

Financial reports include totals/trends, status, garage breakdown, tax and discount totals. Different event date bases must be explicit: invoice issued_at; payment captured_at; refund settled_at; dispute opened_at.

endpoints.title: Read financial totals and breakdown
endpoints.rules: Return event-date bases and matching filter metadata; payment trends available through finance analytics.

endpoints.title: Find failed/disputed or settled payments
endpoints.rules: Optional customer_id, invoice_id, garage_id, status and disputed filters. Failure and dispute are different dimensions.

endpoints.title: Inspect payment attempt and safe gateway result
Inspect dispute context and evidence
endpoints.rules: Read-only evidence; resolving/closing a gateway dispute needs separate scope.

title: Notification monitoring and operational announcements
rules: Notifications are searchable by recipient role/ID, event type, booking/job/invoice, delivery status and timestamp. In-app read status and push delivery status are distinct.

Announcements select a permitted customer/garage audience, store message, audience snapshot, actor, delivery outcomes and audit record. Preview before send, use idempotency and bound recipient counts.
Sending operational announcements does not authorize marketing campaigns. Permissions, channel consent, text limits, delivery provider, recipient scope and suppression policies need approval.

endpoints.title: Inspect platform notification delivery
endpoints.rules: Optional recipient_id, booking_id, job_id and invoice_id filters.

endpoints.title: Inspect safe delivery attempts
endpoints.rules: Do not expose recipient device tokens, provider credentials or raw provider responses.

endpoints.title: Preview announcement audience
endpoints.rules: All fields required. Resolve recipients within caller scope; proposed title limit 120, body limit 2,000.

endpoints.title: Queue approved operational announcement
endpoints.rules: Both fields required; recent MFA recommended. Persist audience/message snapshot from preview; do not accept changed content with an old preview.

endpoints.title: Inspect audience and delivery totals
endpoints.rules: Recipient totals are distinct recipients; per-channel delivery attempts are separately listed.

title: Support ticket assignment, priority, replies and closure
rules: Support permissions independently control reading, assigning, setting priority, replying and changing status. Assignment targets active authorized support staff.
Proposed statuses: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER, RESOLVED, CLOSED. Priorities: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT. Approve permitted transitions and reopening policy.
Ticket links may include customer, garage, booking, job, invoice and payment. Access to linked financial detail still requires finance.read. Every mutation is audited.
Replies are customer/garage-visible according to the ticket participant context. Internal notes must never leak into external replies; this baseline provides external reply operations only.

endpoints.title: Inspect support ticket and record links
Assign/unassign support staff
endpoints.rules: All fields required; assignee_id may be null to unassign. Validate scope and staff eligibility.

endpoints.title: Change ticket priority
endpoints.rules: All fields required.

endpoints.title: Read ticket messages
endpoints.rules: cursor optional; limit 1..100.

endpoints.title: Reply to customer/garage
endpoints.rules: Both fields required; text nonblank, proposed maximum 2,000 characters. Deduplicate client_message_id.

endpoints.title: Resolve or close ticket

request.resolution: Charges explained and confirmed by the customer.

endpoints.rules: status and expected_version required; resolution required for RESOLVED/CLOSED. Enforce approved transitions.

title: Garage-owner performance statistics and formulas
rules: All statistics use the same normalized date/city/garage/service filters, permission scope and snapshot; exports include filters, generated timestamp and source totals.

Jobs-created/status-cohort basis: jobs created in the selected period; status counts are their current status as_of. Status totals must reconcile to that filtered cohort job list. Do not mix created-in-period and completed-in-period counts without labels.

Average jobs per garage = total cohort jobs / eligible garage count. Eligible garages include zero-job garages in the permitted segment; exclude inactive only when exclude_inactive=true. Return null, not zero, when denominator is zero.

Conversion = converted_by_as_of / eligible_accepted_bookings * 100. Eligible cohort: accepted_at in the selected window, including bookings later CONVERTED; exclude invalid/deleted records under an approved policy. Numerator is the converted subset, not all converted bookings across unrelated dates.

Average completion duration = sum(completed_at - created_at) / completed valid jobs in the created-in-period cohort, measured in hours. Exclude unfinished/cancelled/invalid-timestamp records and return exclusions/sample size; no samples means null.

Average invoice amount = sum(final nonvoid invoice total_amount issued in period) / invoice count. Keep this separate from net collections and paid-invoice count. Collections use captured_at and refunds settled_at.

Owner rankings use a deterministic tie-breaker (owner ID) and an explicit sort metric. Multi-garage owners are one aggregate row with garage_ids. Drill-down rows preserve owner identity and filter scope.

endpoints.title: Compare owners, rankings and operational/finance metrics
endpoints.rules: Optional owner_id and snapshot_id. Without finance.read omit monetary fields with restricted_fields metadata; do not return misleading zeroes.

endpoints.title: Read reconcilable owner-performance totals/averages
endpoints.rules: Return formulas/numerator/denominator and exclusions in metric metadata. Weighted completion mean: (20*4.5+10*6)/30=5 hours.

endpoints.title: Inspect one owner's performance and garage breakdown
endpoints.rules: Financial metrics may be included only with finance.read. Garage/job drill-down uses matching owner_id/garage_id filters.

endpoints.title: Read owner job/conversion/collection trends
endpoints.rules: Provide explicitly labelled bucket date bases and numerators/denominators. Optional finance series requires finance.read.

title: Operational, financial and owner-performance exports
rules: Exports are protected asynchronous resources, not public URLs. Require reports.export plus every data permission needed by the selected report; recheck at download.
Supported proposed types: OPERATIONS, FINANCE, GARAGE_OWNER_PERFORMANCE. CSV and XLSX formats; sanitize spreadsheet-formula injection, redact restricted PII and define retention/size limits.

Every export includes normalized filters, snapshot/as_of, generated timestamp, row count, metric definitions and source totals. GARAGE_OWNER_PERFORMANCE is one row per owner; multiple garage IDs are explicit.
Status: QUEUED, PROCESSING, READY, FAILED, EXPIRED. Failed exports expose a safe error; never silently deliver partial results as complete. Capture format/requester/scope in audit.

endpoints.title: Request authorized filtered report
endpoints.rules: report_type, format and filters required. snapshot_id optional; generate a fresh snapshot if omitted. exclude_inactive applies only to owner performance.

endpoints.title: Poll report generation and reconcile totals
Download protected report
endpoints.response: Binary response: Content-Type: text/csv; Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="garage-owner-performance.csv"
endpoints.rules: Requester or approved supervisory scope only; verify current permission, READY status and expiry. XLSX uses its correct MIME type.

title: Audit trail and unified customer/garage activity
rules: Audit records cover successful/failed login, status/account/role changes, financial actions, announcements and exports; actor, time, IP/device, result, correlation ID and approved before/after details are retained.
Audit is append-only; no admin update/delete audit operation. Protect logs from secret/OTP/token/raw gateway payload leakage. IP/device data is privileged, masked or policy-limited.
Unified activity links customer booking, garage acceptance, job creation/status, invoice, payment and review events using stable IDs/correlation. Missing events are shown explicitly, not invented.
Financial activity fields require finance.read. Audit log read requires audit.read and is itself auditable.

endpoints.title: Monitor linked customer and garage service activity
endpoints.rules: Optional owner_id, event_type, booking_id, job_id, invoice_id filters; apply linked-domain permissions.
